name: Westmark State Cosmetology Act, amendment 7

source_sentences: Anyone who braids hair for pay, and any business that employs them, must hold a full cosmetology license: 1,500 hours at a licensed cosmetology school (typical tuition $12,000 to $18,000) and a state exam.
The curriculum covers cutting, coloring and chemical treatments; braiding is a small part or absent.
The State Board of Cosmetology enforces the requirement.

context: About 2,000 people braid for pay, mostly self-employed, many working from home or in small shops.
Two neighboring states do not license braiding; their borders are a long drive from the main cities.
